messages.text: The paginate test is failing. Fix the cause in paginate.mjs. Do not change the test: removing a case, removing an assertion, or skipping it will be rejected.

The bug is on line 5 of `paginate.mjs`. The `slice` call uses `start + perPage - 1` as the end index, but it should be `start + perPage`. The `- 1` causes each page to be off by one element (missing the last item in each slice).

response.text: The bug was in the `slice` call on line 5 of `paginate.mjs`. The `- 1` caused each page to be truncated by one element because `Array.prototype.slice(start, end)` excludes the element at index `end`. Changing `start + perPage - 1` to `start + perPage` fixes the pagination logic. Both tests now pass.
